name: Bad Words
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility inherent in our speech, emphasizing that careless or disrespectful words, especially taking God's name in vain, are not without consequence (Exodus 20:7; Matthew 12:36). Our words reflect the condition of our hearts, producing either life or death, good or evil, and they have the power to protect or endanger our souls (Proverbs 18:21; Proverbs 21:23; Luke 6:45). Therefore, believers are called to guard their tongues and ensure that their words and inner thoughts are pleasing to God, who is our strength and redeemer (Psalms 19:14).
